Acceptance criteria
The deliverables are considered “accepted” when they meet the following criteria.
・A research paper that includes: literature review, market analysis, competitor analysis, stakeholder interviews

・Literature Review: the literature review should be thorough and has proper citation. In order to be considered thorough, it should include information about Impacted-Weighted Accounts to calculate Impact Score and quadratic voting / funding.
・Market Analysis: the market analysis should encompass the macro-level information on why extended quadratic funding leveraging impact score is necessary.
・Competitor Analysis: the competitor analysis should encompass an examination of different approaches to measure impact as well as different crowd funding platforms that use quadratic voting.

・Research Paper Drafting: The research paper should encompass all of the aforementioned elements and should be saved on Notion with a link that's publicly available.

・As a project owner, I can publish my project.

Outputs

Acceptance criteria
The deliverables are considered “accepted” when they meet the following criteria:
1 Production-ready design in Figma. The design will include the following user stories:
・As a project owner, I can publish my project.
・As a donor, I can connect my crypto wallet and donate assets to a project.
・The donation is matched by the matching pool based on the Extended Quadratic Formula. Extended quadratic formula considers the amount donated, the number of donors, and the donors’ impact points.
・As a project owner, I receive the funds (donation + matched amount).

“Production-ready” means that it doesn’t need more work from designers and is ready for the engineering team to turn the design into code.
2 Video walk-through of the design: The video should include both the design screens as well as a prototype on Figma.
Evidence of Milestone completion

・Video walk-through of the design published on Youtube with a publicly available link.
